This emulator is based on a fork of the DingusPPC, which has been modified to run the 11 patches necessary for unlocking Copland. The emulator is available on a branch of the author's fork, which includes patches for modern systems.

articles.title: katamari architecture
articles.summary: Katamari architecture is a design approach that involves building a star out of mud, similar to the video game Katamari Damacy, but with a focus on algorithmic composition rather than random feature addition. Unlike poorly-directed software development, which tends towards feature addition without attention to composition, katamari architecture involves carefully crafting the algorithm to create a natural, complex structure. This approach has been compared to the Big Ball of Mud architecture, which involves a series of "forces" that conspire to create a complex phenomenon, but katamari architecture is more focused on the algorithmic process.
